ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 45% high-intensity white pixels localized in bilateral lobe patches against a 55% low-intensity black background extending from the peduncle.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity white contiguous blobs located on the distal regions of the left and right lobes, separated by a central low-intensity black longitudinal band. Fine-grain black stippling and mottling are visible at the interior margins of the white patches.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees and a significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration along the entire trailing edge. Notable high-amplitude peaks (5-20 pixels) concentrated on the inner margins of both lobes adjacent to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the distal margins, tapering toward sharp, upward-curving lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density cluster of high-intensity circular calcified nodes (barnacles) concentrated on the superior tip of the left lobe. Isolated dark circular spots (likely scars) are distributed sparsely within the white ventral patches.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed across the central black pigmentation and extending into the lower-right white patch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle colonization on the leftmost fluke tip and numerous thin, linear scarring marks across the lower-central region.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique butterfly-shaped central black pigment region flanked by asymmetrical white patches with jagged interior borders.
